_what_is: Fixed pieces of the email that are not offers or signature: the greeting (by locale) and the lines of the short message for contact forms. Placeholders: {first} first name of the contact, {name} company name, {mailbox} the sender mailbox. 'person' is used when the chosen email belongs to a named person, 'team' when only the company is known, 'anonymous' when even the company name is unreliable.
